name: Another Clue to Sanders' Treasure
label: Item
description: In Westfall, a scrap of Captain Sanders' parchment points the way to his next hidden marker.
intro: In Westfall, a scrap of Captain Sanders' parchment points the way to his next hidden marker.

sections.t: A Trail on the Coastal Bluffs
p: Captain Sanders hid his stolen riches across Westfall, using riddles and buried markers instead of one map that could be seized. This scrap continues the trail from the previous hiding place. It tells the finder to turn north and look for a discarded jug near a lonely windmill above the sea cliffs.
